description: Page reader: one URL to clean markdown (or text) with title, description, author, date and links. Use whenever you need the text of a web page: articles, docs, blog posts, product or pricing pages. Strips navigation, ads and cookie banners so the result is small and fits your context. Static HTML only (no JavaScript rendering, no logins). Returns content, title, description, author, publishedAt, siteName, lang, wordCount, truncated, links[] and finalUrl. Not charged when the page cannot be fetched. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails. Includes free daily calls, no wallet needed.

format.description: markdown (default) keeps headings, links, lists, tables and code; text strips them

links.description: Return the links found in the content (default true)

url.description: Page to read, e.g. https://example.com/blog/post. Public http(s) URLs only; static HTML (no JavaScript rendering)

name: read

content.description: The page as clean markdown or plain text

finalUrl.description: Where the fetch ended after redirects

links.description: Links inside the content, deduplicated, up to 200

region.description: Element the content came from: main, article, role-main, body or document

truncated.description: True when maxChars cut the content

title: Page reader (URL to markdown)
